call.speech.im_here.back: Yes, I'm here and I can hear you. Go ahead.

call.speech.still_there.back: Hello? Are you still on the line?

call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Avoids "μισό λεπτό" because that is a banned stalling phrase.

call.speech.no_wait.back: "half a minute", "a moment", "a minute", "let me see", "I'll check", "wait" (polite), "wait a bit" (informal)

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number you called is not available. Try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Oh, a parcel? Of course, leave it outside the door, thank you very much. / Okay, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, goodbye (formal), goodbye (informal), we'll talk/see you, we'll talk again, all the best going on, take care, bye-bye, until we meet again, good evening (as a parting), good night, enjoy the rest of your day, have a good day, have a good day (ημέρα). Wrap-ups: I have to hang up, I'll call you later, I won't hold you up any more, that's all from me, I have to go, we'll talk later. Ends: Thank you very much for the help, all the best! / Okay, that's all from me, see you! / Thank you, I won't hold you up any longer, goodbye. / Thank you very much, and have a good day! Not ends: We'll talk again at the meeting too, but first tell me about the order. / The delivery man said goodbye and left, but I'm still here listening to you. / Good morning, I'm Maria from the shop, I'm calling about your parcel.
call.speech.closing.note: Added αντίο σας and αντίο σου, the goodbye with the polite or familiar word after it, plus καλή σας μέρα and καλή σας ημέρα. Added the closing example Σας ευχαριστώ πολύ και καλή σας μέρα. Greeting words (γεια σας, καλημέρα) stay out. verified is false.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any address that accepts a JSON POST request with the fields event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → "Post to a channel when a webhook request is received", complete the steps and copy the URL. The old Office 365 connectors have been discontinued.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook and copy the URL. Requires a Google Workspace account.

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: enable it, choose a channel and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter the email and the API key as email:key. Destination: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone) or an email for a personal message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID or a person's email.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: Your Nextcloud address, the user name and an app password (Settings → Security) as user:password, and the conversation token (the last part of its link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create and copy the webhook URL. On your local network, the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Requires your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the number in international format (+…) and the recipients (numbers or group IDs with a comma).

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the destination empty to send to all your devices or enter a device ID or email.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. The group code sends to the group; if empty, it sends only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty for the public one.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: The simplest: a simple token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, without a destination. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with UIDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty for the public one.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any email server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login account is also the sender. Use an app password if one is provided.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (found in Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet "If Webhooks: Receive a web request" with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: The links in notifications use this address. Empty = the gray address; with Docker or for access outside the home, type your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Using the address of this page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After each call the AI writes a short summary. Usually no setting is needed here.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any service compatible with OpenAI works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: It uses the Gemini key by default. For another service, choose "Another service".

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: When a date is agreed in a call (delivery, appointment), the summary includes an "Add to calendar" link.
